lead_head: COP31 climate talks collapse with no deal
lead_cap: Nearly 200 countries fail to agree a declaration. The EU rejects a final text with no move away from fossil fuels.

stories.head: Russian drone hits Kyiv-region flats
stories.cap: At least 14 people missing after a strike on an apartment block, Zelenskiy says.

stories.head: Iran strikes hit Bahrain and Hormuz
stories.cap: Bahrain says an Iranian attack hit an industrial site; tankers struck in Hormuz.

stories.head: Drones hit homes, U.N. site in Khartoum
stories.cap: Pre-dawn strikes damage homes and U.N. premises in Sudan's capital.

stories.head: Cartel kingpin 'El Chapo Isidro' seized
stories.cap: FBI most-wanted Sinaloa figure captured in a firefight that kills 11.

stories.head: Indonesia factory fire · Nigeria boat disaster
stories.cap: Rescuers search for dozens missing after a factory fire kills 3 in Indonesia — and at least 24 die when a boat capsizes in Nigeria.

sources: SCMP, AP, Japan Times, Business Recorder, Dawn (22 Nov 2026)
